shared_elements: a row of repeated similar figures side by side
horizontal band of repeated geometric/floral ornament separating registers
circle or disc form (bowls in A, plain disc in B)
limbs/arms rendered as raised outlined shapes
justification: Both are shallow stone reliefs that combine a row of repeated profile figures with a horizontal band of repeated ornament acting as a register divider, and both use flat outlined shapes against a plain ground. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a polished, finely detailed procession of clothed human figures with vessels arranged in a single strict frieze, while B is a coarse, schematic pillar carving of animals and abstract motifs scattered over several unequal fields.
